description: Where web_fetch cuts a response. Byte i of the served body is i % 251; a fetch of a body of `served` bytes keeps `kept` of them (its first ones), and their sha256 is `sha256`. max_bytes is spec/schema/limits.json's web_fetch.max_bytes, which both languages generate in: each suite checks its own constant against it, then checks the boundary.

cases.name: a page well under the cap
a page one byte short of the cap
a page of exactly the cap
a page one byte past the cap: cut, and the last byte is not kept
